subject.title: retry.provider fields split across settings scopes are silently dropped (deepMergeSettings shallow-merges nested objects)

question: Should OpenClaw land the general recursive settings-merge fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102330, wait for proof on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102333, or require a narrower `retry.provider`-only merge?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the candidate fixes intentionally change nested settings merge semantics across scopes and there are two open landing candidates.

options.title: Land the proven recursive helper fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102330 as the landing path because it has sufficient real behavior proof and focused coverage, accepting recursive nested settings semantics.

options.title: Wait for the parallel candidate
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102333 add real behavior proof first if maintainers prefer that branch's smaller implementation shape.

options.title: Require a retry-only repair
options.body: Ask contributors to preserve lower-scope siblings only for `retry.provider` if maintainers do not want shared recursive nested-object settings semantics yet.

recommendation.title: Land the proven recursive helper fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102330 as the landing path because it has sufficient real behavior proof and focused coverage, accepting recursive nested settings semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and prior merge history connect this person most directly to the settings helper and provider retry forwarding surfaces.
